swarm.builder: hermes_cli.main kanban --board <slug> swarm (one-call SWARM-graph builder: root + N workers + one verifier + one synthesizer, wired into the DAG)
swarm.goal: Make the three HG-KSEOS lanes usable and reliable with the owner-named model per lane (PLAN=openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol medium in Hermes; EXECUTE=opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash via CODEX CLI; VERIFY_SECURITY=openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol medium via CODEX CLI)

what_kanban_swarm_openspec_are_not: They are ORCHESTRATION surfaces (task graph, change record, board), NOT model routers: creating them routes no model and selects no arm.

Which model serves which role is decided by the lane / agent-model binding (the governed profile for the in-Hermes PLAN plane; scripts/hgk-lane-dispatch.py --require-arm --force-rank for the CODEX CLI lanes), independently of these surfaces.
GSTACK has no separate implementation in this repository; it is reported as a named-method / role-map readback, never as an enabled component.
dispatch_note: Cards are recorded graph evidence. The native dispatcher spawns only REGISTERED profiles and delegate_task children ignore card pins (they run delegation.provider/model), so the arms this round actually consumed are proven by the two CODEX CLI dispatch receipts (required_arm == served_arm), not by these card ids.
claim_ceiling: A card id is not a run. This artifact records the graph and its builders; it asserts nothing about the model that served any turn.
